args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The round_money function documented banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN,
per FIN-212) but actually used ROUND_HALF_UP. In half cases like 2.665,
this produced 2.67 instead of the expected 2.66, failing the nightly
build's test_money.py.

Import ROUND_HALF_EVEN and use it in the quantize call.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
`src/money.py` documented banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) but actually called `Decimal.quantize` with `ROUND_HALF_UP`. This broke the nightly build: `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` expects `round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == Decimal("2.66")` (banker's rounding), but `ROUND_HALF_UP` yields `2.67`.

## Fix
Import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money` so half-cent cases round to the nearest even cent, matching the documented behavior and the test expectation (e.g. `2.675 -> 2.68`, `2.665 -> 2.66`).

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: import `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP` and pass it to `quantize`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed.

Done. Summary of what I did:

**Root cause:** `src/money.py` documented banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) but the implementation imported and used `ROUND_HALF_UP` in `Decimal.quantize`. That made `round_money(Decimal("2.665"))` return `2.67` instead of the `2.66` expected by `tests/test_money.py`, failing the nightly build.

**Steps taken:**
1. Created branch `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding` off main.
2. Committed a fix to `src/money.py`: import `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` and pass it to `quantize` (one-line change, matching the existing docstring).
3. Triggered CI and waited — run `ci-0001` **passed**.
4. Opened PR #101 against main with alex as reviewer: https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101

Per policy, merging into main requires code-owner approval, so I've left the PR open for review rather than merging it myself.
